coverage.meaning: Exact reconciliation of historical balance states against ERC20 Transfers in the retained selected transaction receipts only. Other transactions were not exhaustively collected. A zero residual cannot prove complete history.

method.interval: Opening and closing balances are end-of-block states. Count checked receipt transfers only where openingBlock < transferBlock <= closingBlock.
method.residual: Unexplained net means balance change not explained by the checked receipts. It does not identify a sale, withdrawal, owner, purpose, gross flow or number of missing transactions. Equal unseen inflows/outflows can cancel.
method.timing: Before/after block balances can include other transactions in that block. Exact transaction execution and ownership are distinct claims.
method.retention: Lower bound remains zero; upper bound is min(sample acquired, closing balance). Factory-verified liquidity pools have no trader-retention interpretation.
method.costBasis: No full acquisition/disposal ledger: no FIFO/LIFO lots, realized profit, holder-age cost basis or ASI score is published.
